Introduction:
 started the channel PTT2019 on telegram in his early days of CSE
Preparation. Since then, this channel has become an essential component of everyone’s CSE
journey. The idea is simple, community members send their individual interview transcript to
the admins, which are then posted on our channel. This was started when transcripts were
sold on various channels and ORN market and due to community efforts only this stands demonetised today.
This pdf is just the plain compilation of all the Interview Transcripts of the session
2020-21 which were posted on our channel. This compilation is not that organized due to
paucity of time.
This compilation is based on the initial works done by a user  and I have just
added few other transcripts in his pdf.
Lastly this was possible only because community (the members who appeared for
interview sent us their transcripts) came forward and hence this is dedicated to the entire
CSE family. I humbly request to those who will benefit from this pdf and are going to appear
for CSPT-2021, please send us your transcripts on the admin handles mentioned in the
description of our telegram channel (ptt2019).
Best Wishes,
Kaptaan and Team PTT

didnot read DAF in detail, but asked few qn from whatever caught their attention from DAF.

1. Be ready for surprises.
2. Go with Zero expectations. Make a mindset that they will ask zero questions from that u have
prepared . It would help you make a good conversation .
3. Smile till you faint . Even smile after that too.
4. Say i dont know freely. i wish i had said that more .

Grandpa mode.

ruin ur confidence & calm .
All the best Everyone . !!
